page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m4.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, paired with 31.0 GB of system memory. A key architectural feature is the inclusion of a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU, providing 0.1667 of a physical GPU with 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include local storage and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates mid-range performance across general compute and memory tasks. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core Geekbench score of 1631.0 and a multi-core score of 8775.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 16850.01. Memory bandwidth is measured at 88.92 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 44.65 GB/sec for write operations. For database workloads, the system processes 16.98 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 4093.14 in Passmark database operations.

The fractional GPU configuration offers a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage for workloads requiring hardware acceleration but not demanding a full, dedicated GPU. This resource density allows users to run lightweight graphics, video transcoding, or small-scale AI workloads without the expense of a whole accelerator. However, the 4 GB VRAM limit and fractional GPU allocation present a clear tradeoff, as seen in LLM inference benchmarks where a small 135M model processes at 198.84 tokens/sec for text generation, but performance drops to a weak 8.13 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model.

This server type is suitable for entry-level GPU-accelerated workloads, virtual workstations, lightweight 3D rendering, video processing, and small-scale machine learning inference. It is also applicable for general-purpose application serving and development environments that benefit from hardware-accelerated APIs.
